messages:
mira-peopleops: Heads-up — Compliance attestation period opens Mon Apr 3 and closes Apr 17 23:59 UTC. All full-time staff and contractors with Redwood accounts must either confirm their role status or upload evidence by the deadline. Form + upload links: https://redwood.example.com/compliance/attest 

mira-peopleops: Quick checklist: 1) Complete the attestation questionnaire. 2) Upload supporting artifacts to the Evidence Locker (link in form). 3) Team leads verify direct reports in the form.

mira-peopleops: Contractors: if onboarding dates overlap this window, flag them in the form by Apr 12 to request a 7-day extension.

tony-englead: For infra teams — what qualifies as minimal evidence for SOC2 control items?

eva-security: Minimal infra evidence = export of asset inventory OR CMDB screenshot + a short note on access controls. App teams: data flow diagram or README + confirmation of encryption-at-rest. If in doubt, upload and mark "for review".

leo-privacy: Note — annual privacy attestation must be completed before you finish the compliance attestation. The brief privacy micro-course (~15 mins) will be surfaced in the form if needed. Aim to finish training by Apr 14 to allow time to upload proof.

reminder-bot: Scheduled: "Compliance attestation window opens" announcement will also post in #general on Apr 4 at 09:00 UTC and send an email digest.

mira-peopleops: Office hours: Apr 10 15:00-16:30 UTC with people-ops + security. Sign-up link inside the attestation form for 1:1 reviews.

tony-englead: We'll consolidate artifacts at the team level and nominate leads to submit. I'll compile names today.

eva-security: We'll triage uploads as "accepted / request more info" and aim to close reviews by Apr 24. If you need expedited review for audits, tag @eva-security in the form.

mira-peopleops: TL;DR — Attestation & evidence due Apr 17 23:59 UTC; privacy training complete by Apr 14; contractor flags by Apr 12; office hours Apr 10. Thanks all, please cascade to any external contractors you manage. :rocket:
